environment.description: Same Terraform provider dashboard binary deployed behind an nginx reverse proxy (v1.25.3) with a location block that applies proxy_hide_header to strip any downstream Content-Security-Policy headers and injects its own via add_header directive. The nginx configuration includes: add_header Content-Security-Policy "default-src 'self'; script-src 'none'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'" always; — Note that the 'always' parameter ensures the header is sent even on error responses (4xx/5xx). The nginx worker_processes is set to auto and the proxy_pass forwards to 127.0.0.1:8080. Additionally, the server block includes proxy_set_header X-Request-ID $request_id for tracing. The CSP uses script-src 'none' which is MORE restrictive than typical 'self' policies — it blocks ALL script execution including same-origin scripts, but the dashboard doesn't serve any legitimate JavaScript so this doesn't break functionality.

config.runtime: EC2, Amazon Linux 2, nginx 1.25.3 reverse proxy
config.network: Security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 on port 443 only, nginx terminates TLS
config.nginx_csp_directive: add_header Content-Security-Policy "default-src 'self'; script-src 'none'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'" always
